name: scientific-research-plugin
description: A full-lifecycle research pipeline for OR & ML, 12 skills + 2 subagents take a project from prior-art survey to the conference talk — Zotero literature intake, structured reading notes, note-driven PDF category highlighting, publication-grade figures, top-journal-style section drafting, LaTeX polishing, noun-term jargon auditing, citation verification against official APIs, three-blind adversarial review, and point-by-point rebuttal. Its prior-art survey covers research-grade questions across engineering and academic sources, not just papers.
